allow: Bash(awk '$1=="blob"{sum[$4]+=$3} END{for \(f in sum\) print sum[f], f}')

PowerShell(Get-ChildItem -Directory | ForEach-Object { $size = \(Get-ChildItem $_.FullName -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum\).Sum; [PSCustomObject]@{Name=$_.Name; SizeGB=[math]::Round\($size/1GB,2\)} } | Sort-Object SizeGB -Descending)

PowerShell(Get-ChildItem -Path "ComfyUI_Custom\\custom_nodes" -Directory | Where-Object { -not \(Test-Path \(Join-Path $_.FullName ".git"\)\) } | ForEach-Object { $size = \(Get-ChildItem $_.FullName -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum\).Sum; [PSCustomObject]@{Name=$_.Name; SizeMB=[math]::Round\($size/1MB,1\)} } | Sort-Object SizeMB -Descending | Select-Object -First 20)
